result.content:
# Diploma project: Dayflow

A Chrome-extension AI agent that automates KBTU student workflows: syncs course files from the WSP portal into a local vault, builds courseware from syllabi, scaffolds project repos and runs team operations (Telegram, Linear, GitHub).

## Architecture
- Brain: Python + Google ADK on Cloud Run (Gemini)
- Hands: Chrome MV3 extension
- State: Firestore, Pub/Sub

## Status
Scenes 1-3 demoable; scenes 4-6 in progress.

# TODO
1. Vault sync on schedule (chrome.alarms)
2. Courseware HTML: cheatsheet + quiz
3. Vault scaffold from syllabus
4. GitHub bootstrap via MCP
5. Team ops: Telegram + Linear + PR
6. Pitch deck generator (.pptx)
7. README + architecture diagram
8. Demo video
